title: Two seatbid entries name the same seat, which the spec never sanctions

knownGap.note: SeatBid.seat identifies the buyer seat on whose behalf a bid is made (OpenRTB 2.6 §4.2.2); two SeatBid entries claiming the same seat conflate distinct bidders, but rules-response.js has no presence, type or uniqueness check for seatbid[].seat anywhere, so the collision validates cleanly.
